tutorial_desc:
Ensure your phone and PC are on the same Wi-Fi.
Visit this URL on your phone:
state_click_resume: Click the speaker above to unmute
install_desc_init:
Downloading and configuring the virtual audio cable for the first run.
This will take about 10 - 20 seconds.
uninstall_desc_doing: Cleaning up underlying audio routing, please wait...
uninstall_desc_success:
A system restart is recommended later to clean up registry remnants.

The program will now exit safely...
uninstall_desc_lost: Connection to the core service has been lost. Please close the window manually.
uninstall_dialog_text:
After uninstalling, Poros will no longer be able to route the phone's sound to other software (such as games/voice applications).

The uninstallation process takes about 2-3 seconds, and it is recommended to restart the computer later to thoroughly clean up any residues.
reminder_desc:
The virtual audio cable has been configured!

Windows may have automatically switched your Default Playback Device to CABLE Input, causing your PC to temporarily lose sound.
Please click the speaker icon 🔊 in the bottom right corner of your screen and manually switch back to your original speaker.
m_alert_desc: Please allow browser access to the microphone.
tray_hint: Poros is still running in the tray
about_body: WebRTC over LAN - no cloud, no account.
m_pin_required: Enter the PIN shown on the PC
m_pin_wrong: Wrong PIN. Check the code shown on the PC.
driver_ready: The virtual audio device is already set up.
driver_create_failed:

{detail}
driver_missing: No Poros virtual audio device found.
driver_remove_failed:
Could not remove the virtual audio device:
{detail}
driver_uninstaller_missing: Uninstaller not found; it may already have been removed.
driver_uninstall_status: The uninstaller returned an unexpected status: {detail}
driver_manual_install:
Install BlackHole manually:
brew install blackhole-2ch
or download it from https://github.com/ExistentialAudio/BlackHole
driver_manual_uninstall:
Remove BlackHole manually:
brew uninstall blackhole-2ch
driver_post_install:
The virtual audio device is ready.

In games or meeting apps, set the microphone device to:
"{device}"

If it does not appear, reopen the app you were using.
pactl_missing: pactl is not available; check that PulseAudio/PipeWire is installed.
error_connect: Could not connect to the server: {detail}
error_audio_device: Could not open the audio output device: {detail}
camera_unavailable: The virtual camera component is missing.
camera_none: Turn the camera on from the phone first.
camera_transport_hint: TCP is reliable; UDP is lighter but can drop frames
camera_loopback: The phone did not report a reachable address - check that it is on the same Wi-Fi.
